screening_rules: Read current PROGRESS pending records; directory absence alone never establishes missing FIRST.
Exclude any current registry/progress image, including image resolved through reused_visible_asset_from across IDs. Existing art needing repair is not missing.
Inspect every nested version for result, BUILTIN_GENERATION, raw, attempt, execution receipt and unknown evidence; reconcile progress calls by exact ID path segment.
A definitive API HTTP400 rejection overrides generic failed_or_unknown receipt wording for factual outcome, but prior submission is NOT an unissued FIRST and no automatic resubmission is authorized.
A source-catalog alias only merges original-source IDs; it is not proof that produced artwork exists. Reverse-alias drawing folders are separately checked.
Never-issued list is inventory only: scene/sequence gates, current permissions, source review and execution release still apply; this report authorizes no calls.
Immediately before any later execution, re-read current registry/PROGRESS and re-scan execution files, because root or another producer may have progressed.
